tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool, quiet neutral so the carpet colors carry the warmth.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, screenshot frames and inputs on ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons and inputs on ground and surface (3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on ground and surface. Fill of the primary button. Focus ring. The letters of the wordmark on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Label on an ink fill, such as the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and descriptions on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and metadata on ground and surface.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: The brand color, from the madder-red field of a dragon carpet. Field of the app icon and of illustrations; the dragon in the wordmark on light grounds. A fill, never body text. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-madder
tokens.usage: The dragon, lines and text on a madder fill (5.4:1).

tokens.name: madder-text
tokens.usage: Madder as text or a link on ground and surface.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The second field color, from carpet medallions. Alternate icon tile, illustration fields. Disappears on the dark ground, so never use it bare there.

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: The dragon, lines and text on an indigo fill.

tokens.name: wool
tokens.usage: Undyed wool. The dragon and border lines inside illustrations and on icon tiles; the whole logo on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Small details in illustrations: stars and diamonds on madder or indigo. Never text, never a background.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: A tint of madder for reflections and faint outlines on a madder field. Illustration only.

tokens.name: product-teal
tokens.usage: Screenshot Capture Studio: icon tile, primary button and status dot on its own page.

tokens.name: product-cobalt
tokens.usage: PostHog Debugger (unofficial): icon tile, primary button and status dot on its own page.

tokens.name: product-violet
tokens.usage: Window Resize Manager: icon tile, primary button and status dot on its own page.

tokens.name: on-product
tokens.usage: Glyph and label on any product color. Every product color must reach 4.5:1 against it.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Small tools that do one job well.
styles.usage: Hub hero headline. One per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Sets any window to an exact size.
styles.usage: The one sentence under a headline. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A tool is finished when it does its job well, not when it has many features.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Keep the sizes you use often and apply one with a click.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels and tags. Capitals echo the wordmark.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Exact values only: sizes, versions, shortcuts, dates.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inset of the border line inside an illustration or icon tile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter. Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between columns of text.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and cards. The system is sharp; nothing is rounder than this except icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Screenshot frames.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App and product icon tiles on the web and in Chrome.
